overview: Quality Management is the field concerned with Building quality in, not inspecting it in: the systems behind reliable products and services. Current Research Frontiers in Quality Management belongs to its essential core. Concretely: Root cause analysis — the 5 Whys and fishbone diagrams finding true causes. And ISO 9001 — the international standard systematizing quality management. Mastering this entry means being able to explain the topic in plain sentences, recognize it in real cases, and apply it alongside the neighboring ideas of the Advanced tier.
